scope: public upstream renderer source inspection; not owner classroom or current deployed-source attestation
findings: Current public RadioComponent documents custom toggle-button semantics rather than native radios
Choice group is fieldset/visible legend then ul[data-widget=radio][role=list] and li[role=listitem]
Choice indicator uses button[aria-pressed], aria-labelledby referring to indicator and visible content
Both single and multiple-select use toggles; explicit Choose 1 directive is required to certify single selection
aria-disabled=true indicates review-mode control that must not be changed
No private application state, correctness configuration or grade APIs are used
